LESSON: VOLUME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.3: Volume
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volume, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we apply the volume of cubes and cuboids in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

1. Discuss in purposive pairs or groups and carefully arrange blocks or objects on top of each other into cuboid and cube shape.
